description: This Java source file defines the AttributesCreated event class used in the Eclipse Ditto project, which represents an event emitted after all attributes of a 'thing' have been created. It includes methods for constructing instances, parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON, as well as identifying related classes, methods, and external dependencies.

classes.name: AttributesCreated
classes.description: An immutable class representing the event of attributes being created on a thing within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes details about the created attributes, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata, and provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and instance creation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new AttributesCreated event with specified parameters including ThingId, Attributes, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to deserialize an AttributesCreated event from a JSON string or JSON object, with associated headers.

methods.name: getCreatedAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes associated with the creation event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the created attributes for serialization, based on schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource, which is '/attributes'.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with an updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends the constructed payload (attributes) to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate.
